MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN AXIS (PRIVATE) LIMITE D (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 18 th DAY OF FEBRUARY 2020 
 
 Present 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Imran Ali Khan Director 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AVAILMENT OF LOAN FROM ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRVIATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to avail a loan in the principal amount of Rs . 100,000,000 (Rupees one hundred million) from Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Zeeshan Ali Khan, Chief Executive of the Company, t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company avail a loan in the principal amount of Rs . 100,000,000 (Rupees one hundred million) from the Lender. 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Zeeshan Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Company Secretary
